findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed multiple gallons of milk to be held past date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, milk was discarded. Ensure any TSC item is discarded after its date marking maximum.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-103.11: (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES are informed in verifiable manner of their responsibility to report accordance with LAW, to PIC, information about their health related to disease transmissible through FOOD.  

PIC did not have reporting agreements for all employees during the inspection. Inspector gave them a copy of the reporting agreement distributed by the department. Copy’s were made by PIC and most employees signed during the inspection. Only those out for doctors appointments are currently unavailable. Violation is considered corrected at this time. Inspector will spot check for the last couple signed copies when notified by the PIC that they have been completed.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text: 2-201.11(A) (P) Facility had not yet completed the reporting agreements for their employees and had not yet started tracking any potential food born illnesses. Procedures were discussed with the PIC and copies of the forms distributed by Sangamon County Public Health were distributed during the inspection. Most employees filled out the reporting agreement during the inspection. Inspector will follow up on the 7th for compliance with the code.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
REPEAT> Observed steel wool being used to stuff holes in the cabinet beneath the two compartment sink. The shelf of this base cabinet is also observed warping. Discussed repairing this cabinet and making sure that the materials used to repair, and to seal around pipes are smooth, nonabsorbent and easily cleanable materials.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: 750-151(a) The facility has a block of American cheese dated from 3/24/17. The facility has been given a list of the exempt cheeses and we have discussed the seven day rule for American cheese. Facility may choose to purchase smaller packages or freeze a portion of the larger bulk package. Discarded during inspection.  Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.

Discussed installing a new base in this cabinet and caulking around the seams to insure no entrance of pests. See notes in General Comments regarding pest control.   Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e The cabinet beneath the two compartment sink is holding chemicals. This cabinet is observed spotted with mouse droppings. Facility has had Sentinel out to deal with the pests. Keep the cabinet cleaned and free of pest droppings. Sanitize the surfaces where droppings are discovered.  Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.
